subtitle: Your Photos. Your AI. Your Control.

en-US.name: 0711 Vault
en-US.subtitle: Your Photos. Your AI. Your Control.
en-US.description:
0711 Vault is a privacy-first photo and document vault with AI-powered organization. Unlike other cloud services, YOUR data stays on YOUR devices.

🔒 ZERO-KNOWLEDGE ENCRYPTION
• End-to-end encryption with keys only you control
• Your password never leaves your device
• We can't see your photos - ever

🧠 LOCAL AI PROCESSING
• Face recognition that works offline
• Automatic photo organization
• Smart search: "Photos with Mom at the beach"
• Document OCR and categorization

📱 YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICES
• Photos stay on your iPhone, Mac, or home server
• No subscription fees for local storage
• Optional encrypted cloud backup
• Export everything anytime

🎯 FEATURES
• Import from Apple Photos
• Face detection and person tagging
• Location-based organization
• Document vault with OCR
• Semantic search powered by AI
• Biometric unlock (Face ID / Touch ID)
• Dark mode

💡 WHY 0711?
• We believe your memories belong to you
• No ads, no tracking, no data mining
• Open source core
• Made in Germany 🇩🇪

Free your data from Big Tech. Your photos deserve better.
en-US.promotional_text: Your photos. Your AI. Your control. Free your data from Big Tech.
en-US.whats_new: Initial release! Import your photos, let AI organize them, and keep everything private.

de-DE.whats_new: Erste Veröffentlichung! Importiere deine Fotos, lass die KI sie organisieren und behalte alles privat.

app_review_info.notes: This app stores photos and documents locally with end-to-end encryption. The AI processing happens on-device using Apple's Core ML and our custom models. No data is sent to external servers without explicit user consent. The app requires photo library access to import photos.
